issue.title: Rust artifact scans omit hold ownership and status-bucket overrides
issue.description: Proposed by sase-1t3.10.1.1 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note #2. At sase fbc1e34fbc with core list contract 8cedd45d contained in pin 71c59dca, a real scan_agent_artifact_dirs binding call over agent_meta.json containing status_bucket=needs_input and waiting.json containing held_by=holder, hold_expires_at=2000000000 returns none of those keys. Python AgentMetaWire/WaitingMarkerWire and enrich_agent_from_meta_wire already support them, and the filesystem waiting overlay displays them. The Rust full AgentMetaWire/WaitingMarkerWire and scanner omit them; git show 8cedd45d^:crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/wire.rs also lacks all three fields, so this is not caused by the compact projection. Add the scalar fields and parsing in sase-core, carry them through the compact list projection as list facts, test source/index/PyO3 and frontend parity, consider cached index refresh, and ship the containing core pin through host finalization. Do not defer these list/grouping facts to selected detail. Searches across all task statuses/types and the last-week task sweep found no semantic duplicate; sase-1qr fixed generic process identity and is distinct. Active capacity epic sase-1sl.1 only optimizes capacity candidate selection, not these missing display fields; no credible active causal owner found.

task_type_fields.impact: Indexed/source-scan agent rows lose hold chips and authored grouping/status-bucket overrides even though the filesystem frontend understands them.
task_type_fields.repro: Create an ace-run directory with agent_meta.json {"name":"fixture","status_bucket":"needs_input"} and waiting.json {"waiting_for":["gate"],"held_by":"holder","hold_expires_at":2000000000}; call sase_core_rs.scan_agent_artifact_dirs(projects_root,[artifact_dir]); inspect records[0].agent_meta and .waiting: all three fields are missing.

issue.creation_reason: Landing triage of sase-1t3.10.1.1 note #2 independently reproduced these omissions in the full Rust scan, which predates the compact-list epic.
